title: Cold-Chain Pharmaceutical Excursion Quarantine & Disposition Engine
required_invariants: excursion_minutes must be non-negative and lot_id non-empty; invalid inputs raise ValueError.
Temperatures within [2.0, 8.0] C with zero excursion minutes must be released.
Any temperature < 0.0 C or > 15.0 C or excursion_minutes > 60 must quarantine_lot immediately.
Mild excursions outside [2.0, 8.0] C within <= 60 minutes must route to qa_stability_review.
